relationships.description: YouthSpark's existing profile includes browser-local visitor connection milestones. This page reads that progress without changing it. It is not a canonical affection or trust score, and it does not represent a persistent relationship with an AI service.

rules: Relationship records reference canonical character IDs from assets/data/characters.json.
Do not invent character relationship values, affection scores, trust scores, shared events, or canon.
Visitor progression is distinct from canonical character relationships and must be labeled as a local prototype.
Personal journal entries belong to the player and must not be converted into character memories or lore automatically.
Relationship progression must not grant items, unlock quests, or alter character canon unless an explicit approved mapping is added.
Cloud persistence, account identity, multiplayer synchronization, and AI memory are not implemented in this phase.
